testPlan.title: shape runs + no T links + spline snap

test.title: The game loaded this build
test.hint: Ticks itself: the running build is the one this plan was packed with.

test.title: No link at a T with a road
test.hint: Road runs: build the field track to the road, and the lane that had the diagonal link. Each ends at the road's edge with no link into the road's lanes.

test.title: Shape a picked run with handles
test.hint: Road runs: pick a road - handles appear on it. Drag one (ticks itself), click the line to add one, ctrl-click one to remove, drag an end onto a waypoint (yellow). Click another pick to select it; 'drop selected run' on the card. Build: the shaped line is laid.

test.title: Spline snap is tighter; Alt places without snapping
test.hint: Spline tool: near a waypoint the point only snaps when right on it (yellow marker). Hold Alt: it never snaps (white marker).

test.title: Click on the curve adds a point
test.hint: Spline tool: click on the drawn curve (green marker): a point goes into the line there.
